nodes.label: Bind attestation to original source transaction
nodes.description: Identical source burns can have identical immutable message bytes. Recovery requires Circle sourceTxHash to match the recorded original burn. Wrong-hash regression failed before fix; suite now passes 54/54.
nodes.rationale: Immutable-byte comparison alone cannot distinguish otherwise identical burns; source transaction binding prevents accepting another burn's attestation.

nodes.label: Testnet API lifecycle
nodes.description: GET snapshot/session token; POST creation, refresh and bridge/quote/swap/pay/recover/retry/reconcile actions. Actions run asynchronously; UI polls every 2.5 seconds. Public serialization strips signed bytes.

nodes.label: Distinct persisted testnet stages
nodes.description: Base created→bridging→funded; Arc starts funded; quoted→swapping→converted→paying→paid→reconciled. Recover bridging/swapping/paying only. Explicit retry requires freshly confirmed reverted bridge stage; retrying mint preserves successful burn. Only paid reconciles; quote expires in 60 seconds.

nodes.label: Receipt-proven reverted CCTP retry
nodes.description: Explicit retry requires fresh verification of the current reverted bridge receipt, preserves prior hashes and advances that stage attempt; retrying mint never repeats a successful burn. Mocked RPC regression coverage; no live reverted bridge proof.
nodes.rationale: A confirmed revert permits a controlled new attempt; timeout or pending attestation alone does not authorize another transfer.

nodes.label: Remaining recovery coverage boundary
nodes.description: Historical 2026-09-27 local signer evidence: Approval-only recovery, converted state, and confirmed CCTP burn during approximately 24-minute attestation wait survived actual server restarts. Original burn used once; both proofs reconciled. Reverted-stage retries use mocked RPC and fresh receipt checks. Full network fault/reversion coverage and SDK atomic batch recovery remain unestablished; reviewed live path is sequential.
